title: Fractional Assignment with $\ell_1$ Preferences
abstract: arXiv:2609.18299v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study a fractional assignment setting where $n$ objects are to be assigned to $n$ agents with unit capacity, and each agent specifies an ideal distribution over the objects. Unlike in classic random assignment, these ideal distributions are not necessarily degenerate, as agents may prefer a mixture of objects rather than any single object. We assume that agents seek to minimize the $\ell_1$ distance between their ideal distribution and the distribution they receive, which is equivalent to maximizing the overlap between the two distributions. We propose two mechanisms, one based on water filling (WF) and the other on quadratic programming (QP), and show that both mechanisms are utilitarian-optimal (and hence Pareto efficient), envy-free, strategyproof, and satisfy equal treatment of equals. translated_title: 基于 $\ell_1$ 偏好的分数分配问题
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个分数分配设置，其中 $n$ 个对象需要分配给 $n$ 个具有单位容量的智能体（agent），每个智能体都指定了一个关于对象的理想分布。与经典的随机分配不同，这些理想分布不一定是退化的（单点分布），因为智能体可能更偏好对象的最优混合而非任何单一对象。我们假设智能体力求最小化其理想分布与实际获得分布之间的 $\ell_1$ 距离，这等价于最大化两个分布之间的重叠。我们提出了两种机制，一种基于注水算法（WF），另一种基于二次规划（QP），并证明了这两种机制都是功利最优的（因此是帕累托有效的）、无嫉妒的、防策略操纵的，并且满足同等者的平等对待。此外，我们强调了每种机制的独特优势：WF 机制满足更强的群体防策略操纵性质，而 QP 机制……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文针对智能体偏好为理想概率分布且以 $\ell_1$ 距离度量效用的分数分配问题，提出了注水（WF）与二次规划（QP）两种机制，证明二者均满足功利最优、无嫉妒、防策略操纵与同等者平等等优良性质，且 WF 机制还满足更强的群体防策略操纵性。
en_tdlr: This paper studies fractional assignment where agents have non-degenerate ideal distributions and minimize the $\ell_1$ distance to their allocation, proposing water-filling (WF) and quadratic programming (QP) mechanisms that are both utilitarian-optimal, envy-free, strategyproof, and satisfy equal treatment of equals, with WF further guaranteeing group-strategyproofness.
